name: May Wong
source:
Likes: Mario
Dislikes: ???

May is Mario’s stalker. She loves him very much. She’d follow him anywhere.
May is always smiling and full of life. She has twintails, loves Risu, and is even a schoolgirl. Behind May’s smile is a past Mario must defeat.
